cross_checked_corrections: Driver configuration output is followed by an F-Curve; AVERAGE plus SINGLE_PROP does not alone prove final identity mapping
Residual (1,1) is a failure mode to inspect, not a claim that every Blender creation path always creates that knot
Driver graph X is configuration output, not animation frame; API argument names do not establish angle units
Relative key snapshots subtract their own Relative To reference and add to the mix; copying a mixed target can duplicate existing Depth/Mouth/slack displacement
Panel labels New Combined while Workflow says New Shape from Mix; versioned documents themselves do not justify blindly automating either menu label
C2 spatial boundary continuity does not guarantee an acceptable highlight, and F-Curve temporal/input interpolation is a separate continuity question
Preserving UV values does not preserve surface metric or texture density after deformation
Interior rigid translation and fixed boundary require a deforming transition; global rigid translation cannot satisfy both
Interior profile preservation is not physical closed-volume, material-length or pocket-capacity preservation

own_design_and_derivation.status: Application proposals, not formulas recommended by Blender for wallets
items: Quintic clamped transition with endpoint first/second derivatives zero
Separable rectangular shoulders with independent amplitude, shoulder widths and central curvature parameter
Constant-direction interior pocket translation with boundary mask
Transition derivative scaling d/w and d/w^2
